tagline: Your Health. Your Voice. Our Support.
hero.title: Your Health Deserves to Be Heard.
hero.sub: A private space to understand your body, track your health, find support, and make informed decisions.
intro.title: Health information in your language
intro.body: Belluna explains women's health in plain English and Hindi, helps you track patterns, and points you to care when it matters. It does not diagnose.
feat.title: What you can do
feat.ask.d: Plain-language answers with sources, in English or Hindi.
feat.track.d: Log periods and symptoms and see patterns over time.
feat.sos.d: A short check on how urgent your symptoms may be.
feat.care.d: Hospitals and clinics around you on a map.
feat.circle.d: Anonymous peer support rooms for adults.
how.title: How Belluna works
how.3: Know when to see a doctor
privacy.title: Private by design
privacy.body: We collect the minimum. SOS answers stay on your device. Location is used only on the care map, only with your permission, and is never saved.
sos.banner.title: Feeling unwell right now?
sos.banner.body: Answer a few questions to find out how urgent it is.
footer.disclaimer: Belluna shares general health information. It is not a diagnosis or a substitute for a doctor. In an emergency, call 112.
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.stub: Demo sign-in only. Real Supabase authentication will replace this.
dash.log.d: Record flow, pain, mood and symptoms.
dash.ask.d: Ask a question in English or Hindi.
dash.sos.d: Check how urgent your symptoms are.
tr.title: Ask Belluna
tr.sub: Ask a women's health question in English or Hindi.
tr.placeholder: For example: Mere periods irregular kyun hain?
tr.emergency.b: Please call 112 now or go to the nearest hospital.
tr.rate.b: You have used today's questions. Please try again tomorrow.
tr.unavailable: The answer service is not reachable yet.
sos.title: Period SOS
sos.sub: A short check, not a diagnosis. Your answers stay on this device and are not saved.
sos.review: Rules pending clinical review. Do not rely on this result alone.
sos.q.soak: Are you soaking through a pad or tampon every hour for 2 hours or more?
sos.q.faint: Do you feel faint, very dizzy, or have you fainted?
sos.q.pain: Is the pain severe and not relieved by your usual measures?
sos.q.fever: Do you have pelvic pain together with fever?
sos.q.preg: Could you be pregnant and have one-sided pain or bleeding?
sos.q.pregbleed: Are you bleeding during a pregnancy you know about?
sos.r.emergency.b: Your answers include warning signs. Call 112 or go to the nearest hospital.
sos.r.urgent.b: Your answers suggest you should speak to a doctor soon.
sos.r.selfcare.b: No warning signs came up. Rest, drink fluids and use warmth for comfort. Track your symptoms and see a doctor if things get worse.
dr.title: Find nearby care
dr.consent: Belluna can use your location once to find care near you. It is never stored.
dr.none: No facilities found here. Try another city, or call 112 in an emergency.
dr.denied: Location was not shared. Choose a city instead.
dr.fail: Map data is unavailable right now.
dr.nofallback: The curated demo list (content/clinics-demo.json) is not loaded yet.
ph.title: Coming soon
ph.body: This screen will be connected to the team module.
set.title: Settings
set.privacy.b: Belluna stores only what you log. No date of birth, phone number or exact location is collected.
set.delete.b: Deletion is not connected to the backend yet, so nothing has been deleted.
circle.title: Belluna Circle
circle.body: Anonymous peer support for adults (18+). Peers are not medical professionals. No direct messages, images or links.
guest.needed: Please log in to use this page.
